mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( seqMember, name, id, pw, pic, nickname, email, gender, birth, region ) VALUES ( seqmember.nextval, #{name}, #{id}, #{pw}, #{pic}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{gender}, TO_DATE(#{birth}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{region} )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM member WHERE name = #{name} AND email = #{email} AND status != 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE id = #{id} AND email = #{email} AND status != 2

SELECT seqMember, name, id, pw, pic, nickname, email, status, type, failCount, TO_CHAR(regDate, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS regDate, gender, TO_CHAR(birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, region, intro FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT pw FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
